title: Hi, I’m Ani
text:
PySpark demo
A small example running on my AWS EC2 instance:

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = (SparkSession.builder
         .appName("demo")
         .config("spark.ui.showConsoleProgress", "false")
         .getOrCreate())
spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")

df = spark.createDataFrame(
    [("Python", 1991), ("Spark", 2014), ("Quarto", 2022)],
    ["tool", "year"]
)
df.show()
spark.stop()

+------+----+
|  tool|year|
+------+----+
|Python|1991|
| Spark|2014|
|Quarto|2022|
+------+----+

title: Ani Shaikova
text: I’m a graduate student in the MS in Applied Business Analytics program at Boston University’s Metropolitan College. Originally from Kazakhstan, I come to analytics from a background in international and comparative politics, where I learned to ask good questions about institutions, economies, and people. Now I’m building the technical toolkit to answer them with data: Python, SQL, PySpark, and cloud platforms like AWS.
